rules.rule: TypeScript strict mode, Node 22. ESLint owns style, do not comment on it. Focus on runtime bugs: un-awaited or unhandled promises, off-by-one loops, unsafe casts through any or unknown, swallowed errors, missing cleanup of subscriptions and timers, state updates after unmount.
Same as TypeScript: runtime bugs only, ESLint owns style.
Flag dependencies added with caret or wildcard ranges when the repository pins exact versions elsewhere, and scripts that download and execute remote content.
